title: Embedding rooted blow-ups of tree posets
summary: A tree poset $T$ is a poset whose Hasse diagram is a tree. Bukh proved that if a family $\mathcal F\subseteq 2^{[n]}$ contains $(h(T)-1+\varepsilon)\binom{n}{\lfloor \frac{n}{2}\rfloor}$ sets, then $\mathcal F$ contains a weak copy of $T$, where $h(T)$ is the height of $T$, the number of elements in a longest chain of $T$. Several strengthenings and generalizations of this result have been obtained. We prove the following robust variant.
